A separate address attributed by onchain analysts to Nasdaq-listed Hyperliquid Strategies accumulated and staked another 365,000 HYPE (~$29.65M) in 24h; over 15 days it reportedly accumulated/staked 3.029M HYPE (~$252M) at an average ~$83.40.

The fee-funded Assistance Fund reportedly bought and burned 32,770 HYPE (~$2.65M) in the latest 24h at an average $81.01, versus 9,730 HYPE (~$829.5K) in a Sep. 6 comparison, materially accelerating direct token value capture.

Hyperliquid still leads onchain perps with about $8.729B 24h volume and $13.975B open interest. OI is modestly below the Sep. 10 checkpoint rather than accelerating, so this is a persistence/value-capture confirmation, not a fresh leverage-volume breakout.

HYPE is around $79.35, below the prior Sep. 10 signal price of $84.02 and about 11% below its Sep. 6 ATH, so this paper entry is prospective at the current observable mark rather than taking credit for the earlier rally.
